get.description: Liveness check for scripts: 200 when the database is reachable, 503 otherwise.

Setup checklist data: database, worker, Claude CLI, API keys, and network access.

Claude's version and sign-in are cached for a few minutes; `recheck=true` asks again now.

post.description: Back up the database now (the worker also does this every night).

get.description: Everything the presentation deck shows, gathered in one response.

put.description: Replace what the travelers enjoy. The trip form doesn't touch this list.

post.description: Fetch Wikipedia summaries and photos again for destinations that don't have them.
Check prices now (all routes, or the ones listed).

get.description: Latest price per itinerary, cheapest first.

put.description: Make a fare the trip's flight: the trip's dates move to its departure and return.

delete.description: Stop using this route's flight for the trip's dates (they stay as they are, now editable).

post.description: Record the flight you booked, leg by leg: it becomes the trip's flight and joins the itinerary.

patch.description: Hide a fare, or confirm one flagged as suspect.

get.description: Every day of the trip (plus any outside its dates that have activities), with a summary of each.

patch.description: Change some fields. `version` must match the server's, or you get 409 and should reload.

get.description:
Things to do by category (`kind`) or by name (`q`): within `radius_m` of a point, or anywhere
in a destination (`within`), nearest the point first. Results are cached for a week.

parameters.name: within

schema.description: A destination id: search all of it.
schema.title: Within

parameters.description: A destination id: search all of it.

get.description: The English Wikipedia summary for a place, when it has one (null otherwise).
Hours, website, and links for a place found by name (category results already include them).

put.description: Each traveler can heart the places they like.

post.description: Dates and guests from a pasted link; with `fetch`, also the page's title and photo.
Priced vacation rentals for the dates (one SerpApi search; repeats within 12 hours are free).

get.description: Log lines after `after_seq`, for polling while a run is in progress.
What the run saved (prices, notes, suggested activities) and what was rejected, with the reasons.

post.description: Queue a run now. If one is already waiting to start, that run is returned instead.

get.description: Findings saved by research agents, newest first.
Live Google Flights searches used and left under the monthly cap.
Airports near a destination, for suggesting where to fly.
The task: trip, routes with ids and date rules, cheapest known prices, and the rules.

post.description: Up to 50 prices. Each is accepted, rejected with reasons, or reported as a duplicate.
Up to 20 things to do. Each is accepted, rejected with reasons, or reported as a duplicate.
Queue a Claude run that suggests things to do. Poll the run, then read the trip's suggestions.

get.description: The trip's suggestions, newest run first. Without `status`, the new and added ones.

patch.description: Dismiss a suggestion, or bring a dismissed one back.

post.description: Add the suggestion to the itinerary: planned at its day and time, or as an idea with `as_idea`.

get.description:
Weather for each trip day: the forecast for the next 15 days, typical weather (the last five
years' average for that date) for the rest. Days with no destination or no data are left out, so
an undated trip, or one whose weather can't be reached, gives an empty list.

AccessInfo.title: AccessInfo
AccessInfo.description: Whether other devices can open the app, and at which addresses.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version you edited; a newer one on the server means a conflict.

ActivityUpdate.title: ActivityUpdate
ActivityUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed; send null to clear one (e.g. `day: null` makes it an idea).

BackupStatus.title: BackupStatus
BackupStatus.description: Nightly database backups: where they go, the newest one, and the last problem, if any.

BookedFlightIn.title: BookedFlightIn
BookedFlightIn.description: A flight the travelers already booked, entered leg by leg as printed on the ticket.

DayWeather.title: DayWeather
DayWeather.description:
One trip day's weather at its destination, in °F and inches.

`forecast` days are within the forecast's reach and carry `rain_chance`. All other days are
`typical`: averages over the last five years, with `wet_days_pct` (the share of those days that
had at least 0.04 in of rain or snow).

id.title: Id
id.description: Set for destinations that already belong to the trip.

DestinationSuggestion.title: DestinationSuggestion
DestinationSuggestion.description: A place a trip can go, as found by Geoapify.

FlightDates.title: FlightDates
FlightDates.description:
The trip's dates when chosen flights set them: the first departure to the last return.

`end` is None when no chosen flight sets it (a single one-way flight); then only `start` is fixed.

FlightSegment-Input.title: FlightSegment
FlightSegment-Input.description: One flight of a booked itinerary. Times are local wall-clock times at each airport.

FlightSegment-Output.title: FlightSegment
FlightSegment-Output.description: One flight of a booked itinerary. Times are local wall-clock times at each airport.

IntegrationStatus.title: IntegrationStatus
IntegrationStatus.description: Which API keys are configured. Values are never exposed, only presence.

LodgingUpdate.title: LodgingUpdate
LodgingUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; send null to clear one.

PlaceOut.title: PlaceOut
PlaceOut.description: A place from a search, with whatever details the provider already returned.

PlaceRef.title: PlaceRef
PlaceRef.description: The place an activity was added from, as returned by the places search.

RouteSummary.title: RouteSummary
RouteSummary.description: Per-route status for the Flights page.

RoutineConfig.title: RoutineConfig
RoutineConfig.description: Options for agent routines. Price-check (API) routines use none of them.

RunDetailOut.title: RunDetailOut
RunDetailOut.description: A run with what it was asked to do and how it was started.

RunOutputs.title: RunOutputs
RunOutputs.description: Everything a run saved or had rejected.
